prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1244; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a rear-end collision that occurred while our client was stopped in traffic. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is now receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also provide a copy of the declarations page.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, claim file notes, adjuster communications, repair estimates, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please ensure that no such material is altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending. We look forward to your prompt written response.
